careReminders.title: Care reminders

careReminders.outreachDisclaimer: Reminder wording is generated server-side and cannot be changed into free-form external email.
careReminders.queueSubtitle: Due dates use the practice day. Imported tasks retain source identity so retrying a migration cannot duplicate them.
careReminders.selectToDismissPrompt: Select up to 100 invalid reminders to dismiss them safely.
careReminders.emptyOpenDesc: Try another due-date filter, or add a reminder from a patient record.
